description: Used remaining discovery quota to expand configured publisher sources, finish their January histories, refresh new uploads, and supplement new IDs via the independent Search quota. Both discovery buckets returned their daily quota errors.

history_collection.limitation: Completed under collector whole-page cutoff; selected channels only, not a census of Vietnamese YouTube.

supplemental_search.reason: Search Queries per day quota exceeded
supplemental_search.limitation: Search index may lag or omit recent uploads; does not advance uploads checkpoint.

quota_note: Local counters are not Cloud quota usage. playlistItems returned HTTP403 quotaExceeded; Search returned HTTP429 daily Search limit exceeded. No further ordinary/Search requests made after their first daily limit error. Unused statistics quota cannot retrieve more video IDs or titles.
reset_note: Scheduled reset only; not a confirmation of actual project quota availability.
metadata_note: Existing fresh cached videos were not refreshed. 205 new IDs used real batch statistics; titles/dates/channel IDs came from uploads or Search and author from the configured channel registry. Exact method provenance is stored in cache metadata_source and separate response ledger.
source_verification_note: Evidence varies by channel: direct publisher links, verified YouTube identity, or historical directory locator with current profile checks. See verification_note/locator_reference. Blank legacy reference is not a new verification.
resume_note: Resume interrupted uploads pass without --refresh after reset; to extend end date, finish current pass first. Dedicated batch stats and Search ledgers are separate.
analysis_note: Spark/HDFS analysis, models, MongoDB and dashboard were not rebuilt in this crawl.

collection_manifest.source: YouTube Data API v3: playlistItems.list, channels.list, cached videos.list, videos.batchGetStats and supplemental search.list
collection_manifest.batch_stats_note: For these IDs, title/date/channel come from playlistItems.list or supplemental search.list (see cache metadata_source), author from the channel registry, and actual statistics from videos.batchGetStats.
collection_manifest.pending_metadata_note: Uncached rows use the collected title/publication/channel and registry author; statistics and measurement time are blank. Fallbacks are not written to the API cache.
collection_manifest.deduplication: One video ID; one normalized title per channel, keeping the newest publication. Same titles from different channels are retained.
collection_manifest.author_definition: The YouTube publishing channel title; not an individual reporter.
collection_manifest.statistics_definition: Public cumulative counts at metrics_collected_at_utc, not counts on the publication date. Missing counts are blank, never replaced by zero.
